color.note: The app has one theme, dark. Look decides the colors inside the output screens. These tokens don't.

tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window background. The 4px gap between panels, the menu bar, the toolbar, and the status bar use this color.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: The name band under a preview, and the background around the output preview.

tokens.name: bg-well
tokens.usage: A surface one step lower, such as text fields, search fields, the segmented control track, and media tiles.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Background of every panel. The default surface on screen.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Background of the box that groups a list inside a dialog.

tokens.name: bg-dialog
tokens.usage: Background of dialogs and confirmation dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-control-off
tokens.usage: Background of a control that changes nothing when clicked, such as a 지우기 (clear) button with nothing to clear.

tokens.name: bg-toolbar-hover
tokens.usage: Background of a toolbar button on hover, and of the undo button.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Background of menus, popovers, tooltips, and notifications. The selected toolbar button and the hover of a ghost button also use this color.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Background of secondary buttons, dropdown buttons, 지우기 buttons that are on, and thumbnail bands with no 이름표 (label).

tokens.name: bg-control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of filled controls, the selected segment, and the pointed item in a menu.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Thin lines inside a panel: under the panel header, between list sections, and at the edges of dialog headers and footers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px border of floating surfaces such as menus, dialogs, and notifications, menu dividers, and the track of a switch that is off.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The border of a checkbox that is off, and the dashed line that marks an empty slot in a 틀 (template). It is a control boundary, so it keeps 3.2:1 or more on bg-dialog and bg-inset.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 10.6:1 or more from bg-app to bg-control-hover, and 8.6:1 on selection.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ghost button icons, property names. 6:1 or more up to bg-control-hover, and 4.9:1 on selection.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Counts, dates, shortcuts, group headers, status bar. Use it only on bg-panel, bg-dialog, and bg-raised (4.5:1 or more). Don't use it on bg-control, where it is 4.3:1.

tokens.name: text-off
tokens.usage: 지우기 buttons with nothing to clear, screen output buttons that are off, disabled items. Don't use it for text that must be read (3.3:1 on bg-panel).

tokens.name: text-on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill and live (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-on-label
tokens.usage: Text and icons on 이름표 color bands and macro tiles (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-on-selection
tokens.usage: Secondary text and count badges on selection (5.9:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The line blue. Keyboard focus rings, the outline of a selected thumbnail, text field focus, drop position marks. To fill a surface, use accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: The surface blue. Primary buttons, checkboxes and switches that are on. White text reads at 4.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of a primary button. It is one step darker than accent-fill, so white text reads at 5.4:1.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the selected row in a list, the selected service, and the selected media tile.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Use it only for what is on the screens right now: the 3px outline of the live 장 (slide), the LIVE badge, the dot of a screen output that is on, the outline of the live background, and the outline of a field with a duplicate title.

tokens.name: live-tint
tokens.usage: A very faint background that groups live items (the 표시 중 (showing) list in 진행 도구 (show tools)).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A missing monitor, a missing media file, conflicting shortcuts. Use it for text, icons, and outlines (7.7:1 on bg-panel).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a chip or text cell that shows a warning state. Draw notification cards with bg-raised and a warning icon.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The 6px dot of a healthy state (fps and NDI connection in the status bar). Don't use it for anything but the dot.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a healthy state chip.

tokens.name: chroma
tokens.usage: Background of the capture window for 방송 자막 (broadcast captions) and of its preview. Don't use it as a UI color.

tokens.name: output-black
tokens.usage: Default background of output screens and thumbnails.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The layer that covers what is behind a dialog. It starts under the menu bar.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Background of small text chips over pictures (media duration, copy percentage). It keeps text readable even on bright pictures.

tokens.name: label-teal
tokens.usage: 이름표 color. Paint the whole thumbnail band and the 구성 (arrangement) chip with it, and use text-on-label for the text.

tokens.name: label-green
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-yellow
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-orange
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-rose
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-violet
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-slate
tokens.usage: 이름표 color.

tokens.name: label-gray
tokens.usage: 이름표 color. Also the color of the number on a band with no 이름표.

tokens.name: label-none
tokens.usage: The band when no 이름표 color is picked. The text is label-gray.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Confirmation dialog titles, page titles in the Preferences window.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog headers, the song title in a panel header.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: List rows, menu items, text fields, md buttons. The default text of the app.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names to emphasize in a list, md primary buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: sm buttons and dropdowns, property names, short marks with no secondary description.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Tabs in a panel header, sm primary buttons.

styles.name: band
styles.usage: The number and name in the 이름표 band under a thumbnail, 구성 chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counts, dates, durations, status bar, the second line of a two-line list.

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: List group headers, 지우기 button names, keycaps.

styles.name: toolbar-label
styles.usage: The name under the icon of a toolbar button.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Very small marks such as the LIVE badge. Don't use it anywhere else.

spacing.note: The base is a 4px unit, but intermediate values such as 2px, 6px, 10px, and 14px exist only where they are actually used.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding of the segmented control track, the gap between the lines of a two-line list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gap between panels, between a toolbar button icon and its name, and between 지우기 buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between an icon and short text (sm button), menu padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between an icon and text in a button (md), between dialog buttons, horizontal padding of menu items.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between the icon and text in a list row, horizontal padding of sm buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Horizontal gap in the thumbnail grid, between boxes in a dialog.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Panel padding and horizontal padding of list rows. All content in a panel starts 14px from the left.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, vertical gap in the thumbnail grid.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the status bar and the gap between its items, the gap between panel tabs.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Confirmation dialog padding, the gap between items in the input bar at the bottom of a dialog.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections in the Preferences window.

tokens.name: panel-gap
tokens.usage: Between panels, and between the window edge and panels.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Panel padding. Header text, list text, and grids all align to this line.

tokens.name: dialog-inset
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of dialog headers, bodies, and footers.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small graphics inside buttons, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments, chips, badges, menu bar items, keycaps, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, dropdowns, thumbnails, menu items, 지우기 buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, toolbar buttons, two-line list items, segmented control tracks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, confirmation dialogs, notifications.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: 64px macro tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, switches, slider thumbs.

shadow.note: Don't use shadows on panels. Use shadows only on floating surfaces (menus, dialogs, notifications).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, submenus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, confirmation dialogs, notifications.

tokens.name: ring-live
tokens.usage: The outline of the 장 and the background media that are live now.

tokens.name: ring-selected
tokens.usage: A selected thumbnail that isn't live, a selected macro tile.

tokens.name: ring-field
tokens.usage: The outline of a bg-well text field placed on a surface close to bg-well.

tokens.name: ring-field-focus
tokens.usage: A text field with focus.

tokens.name: ring-field-error
tokens.usage: A text field that holds a value that can't be saved (a duplicate song title).

tokens.name: ring-dot-cut
tokens.usage: A ring that separates a status dot placed on an icon from the icon.

tokens.name: ring-dot-cut-hover
tokens.usage: The status dot ring on a toolbar button on hover (the same color as its background, bg-toolbar-hover).

size.note: Fixed heights and widths. For column widths that depend on the window size, follow "Window sizes and layout" in the README.

tokens.name: size-menubar
tokens.usage: Height of the menu bar (which also serves as the window title bar).

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Toolbar height (regular window).

tokens.name: size-toolbar-compact
tokens.usage: Toolbar height (narrow window). Button names go to the right of the icon.

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: size-panel-header
tokens.usage: Panel header height.

tokens.name: size-panel-footer
tokens.usage: Panel footer row (the row with the thumbnail size slider).

tokens.name: size-control-xs
tokens.usage: Segments, chips. They fit inside a 26px track.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, dropdowns, and icon buttons in panels.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and text fields in dialogs, Preferences, and property fields, and the toolbar search field.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: One list row.

tokens.name: size-row-menu
tokens.usage: One menu item row.

tokens.name: size-row-double
tokens.usage: Two-line list item (service picker).

tokens.name: size-toolbar-button
tokens.usage: Toolbar button (icon on top, name below).

tokens.name: size-toolbar-button-compact
tokens.usage: Toolbar button in a narrow window (icon on the left, name on the right).

tokens.name: size-clear-button
tokens.usage: Buttons in the 지우기 row.

tokens.name: size-clear-button-compact
tokens.usage: 지우기 button in a narrow window (icon only).

tokens.name: size-dialog-header
tokens.usage: Dialog header.

tokens.name: size-dialog-footer
tokens.usage: Dialog footer.

tokens.name: size-dialog-aside
tokens.usage: Width of the left list in a dialog, as in 새 예배 (new service) and 다른 예배에서 가져오기 (import from another service).

tokens.name: size-alert-icon
tokens.usage: Left icon cell of a confirmation dialog.

tokens.name: size-thumb-band
tokens.usage: 이름표 band under a thumbnail.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: LIVE badge height.

tokens.name: size-count
tokens.usage: Height of count badges and keycaps.

tokens.name: size-icon-12
tokens.usage: Dropdown arrows, the check inside a checkbox, submenu arrows.

tokens.name: size-icon-14
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and menus, window control buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-16
tokens.usage: Type icons in list rows, icons in panel headers and text fields. The default for icons with no size given.

tokens.name: size-icon-18
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, 지우기 buttons, large icons in 퀵 실행 (quick launch).

tokens.name: size-icon-24
tokens.usage: Confirmation dialog icon.

tokens.name: size-icon-28
tokens.usage: Icons inside macro tiles.

tokens.name: size-prop-label
tokens.usage: Width of the name cell in property rows in panels (right column).

tokens.name: size-prop-label-wide
tokens.usage: Width of the property name cell in settings windows such as Preferences.

tokens.name: size-prop-row
tokens.usage: Height of property rows in panels.

tokens.name: size-prop-row-wide
tokens.usage: Height of property rows in settings windows.

tokens.name: col-left
tokens.usage: Width of the left column (예배 순서 (service order), 퀵 실행, library), regular window.

tokens.name: col-right
tokens.usage: Width of the right column (preview, 지우기, 진행 도구, properties), regular window.

tokens.name: col-left-compact
tokens.usage: Left column width, narrow window.

tokens.name: col-right-compact
tokens.usage: Right column width, narrow window.

tokens.name: col-left-wide
tokens.usage: Left column width, wide window (2400 or more).

tokens.name: col-right-wide
tokens.usage: Right column width, wide window.

tokens.name: col-center-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the center column.

tokens.name: dialog-s
tokens.usage: Confirmation dialog width.

tokens.name: dialog-m
tokens.usage: Small dialogs, such as 출력 상태 복구 (output state recovery).

tokens.name: dialog-l
tokens.usage: Dialogs that pick one item from a list, such as 새 예배 and 다른 예배에서 가져오기.

tokens.name: dialog-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs that need a wide preview, such as 텍스트 가져오기 (import text).

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum window width (CSS pixels after Windows display scaling).

tokens.name: window-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum window height.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-notification
tokens.usage: Notifications. They show above dialogs too.
